task: Template engine (tokeniser, recursive-descent parser, sealed AST, evaluator) with line/column errors
reasoning_summary: A mode-switching lexer produces text/output/tag tokens (with trim markers); a block parser builds a sealed Node tree and an expression parser (or/and/not/comparison precedence, filters) builds a sealed Expr tree. A pattern-matching renderer evaluates with lexical scopes that never touch the caller's map. Every token carries an absolute offset so syntax and render errors report exact line/column; 67 tests with hand-derived positions, mutation spot checks and a seeded fuzz passed on the first run.
